# Route-policy inventory rows that prove no policy decision yet.
#
# tests/test_route_policy_inventory.py::_report fails when a row proves
# nothing (no denial, no category refusal where one is required, no explicit
# route contract) unless that pass lists the row here, and it fails when a
# listed row starts to prove policy. So this list can only shrink.
#
# Each entry is "METHOD template STATUS"; a listed row that changes status
# fails too. The comment is the outcome when the entry was recorded. Typical causes: the request recipe stops at
# body validation or an unknown sample ID before policy; a provider is not
# configured in the hermetic config; or, in category passes, the refusal
# carries no "category rules:" reason. To remove an entry, make the request
# reach policy or give the route an explicit contract in the test.
